en.headline: 14 own commits across two repositories, plus 8 automated commits
en.summary: **14 own commits** were recorded across `sogeisetsu/opencode-agent-sandbox` and `sogeisetsu/pixel-logo-toolkit`, alongside 8 automated commits by `github-actions[bot]` in `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu`. In `sogeisetsu/opencode-agent-sandbox`, 12 own commits added Hunyuan 4 pelican-bike-riding test results and a four-version comparison, archived the evaluation artifacts and prompt text, and updated the knowledge base. Those changes clarified `AGENTS.md` as the agreed single landing point, removed conversational and first-person wording, corrected the LSP description to match the official migration guide, and documented the `experimental.todo` switch for `todowrite`. Further commits added source evidence that LSP runtime support is unimplemented, described `browser` as a namespace, rewrote the built-in tool list for V1/V2, reviewed the tool repository, updated the directory index with criteria for `enhance-prompt`, and recorded the desktop harness list with OpenCode V2 comment and tool comparisons. The repository also began ignoring the `.workbuddy` project data directory. In `sogeisetsu/pixel-logo-toolkit`, 2 own commits upgraded the gallery into a GitHub Pages homepage with bilingual, light/dark, and copy-command features driven by Markdown, and added 12 Xiaohongshu-style covers plus a browsable gallery page. No pull requests, issues, reviews, releases, or discussions were recorded.

zh.headline: 两个仓库共 14 次本人提交，另有 8 次自动提交
zh.summary: **14 次本人提交**分布在 `sogeisetsu/opencode-agent-sandbox` 和 `sogeisetsu/pixel-logo-toolkit`，另有 8 次由 `github-actions[bot]` 在 `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu` 自动提交。`sogeisetsu/opencode-agent-sandbox` 的 12 次本人提交新增混元 4 版鹈鹕骑车实测与四版对比，归档评测产物并登记提示词原文，同时更新知识库。相关改动明确 `AGENTS.md` 为约定唯一落点，去除对话式自省与第一人称表述，按官方迁移指南改正 LSP 口径，并补录 `todowrite` 的 `experimental.todo` 开关。后续提交补充 LSP 运行时未实现的源码证据，说明 `browser` 是命名空间，按 V1/V2 双文档重写内置工具清单并复检工具仓库，更新目录索引与 `enhance-prompt` 的形态判据，并收录桌面 harness 清单及 OpenCode V2 评论与工具对照。该仓库还开始忽略 `.workbuddy` 项目数据目录。`sogeisetsu/pixel-logo-toolkit` 的 2 次本人提交将画廊升级为 GitHub Pages 首页，提供双语、明暗主题与复制命令，内容改由 Markdown 驱动，并新增 12 张小红书风格封面和可浏览的画廊页面。当天没有记录拉取请求、issue、评审、发布或讨论。
